records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Harbor Systems!
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero engagement: no reply to either outreach (email:fc49f549, email:9f16eb4c), no project, no invite, no tickets. Silent accounts with no first project by day 6 rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though Starter single-admin setups can still act abruptly.

draft.subject: Getting Harbor Systems' first project into Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Checking in after my welcome note last week. Nothing's set up in Wrenfield yet, and I'd rather that not sit on your plate unnoticed.

The quickest way in: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually enough to see whether Wrenfield fits how Harbor Systems works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Inviting your team can follow from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you, or just answer questions by email.

Best,
Nadia
